title: GCP resource name
summary: A Google Cloud resource name identifies a resource hierarchically: //service.googleapis.com/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/{resource-type}/{resource-id}. Short form: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/{resource-type}/{resource-id}.

notes: Resource names are case-sensitive and must be unique within their parent.
Used in IAM, Cloud Asset Inventory, and API calls.
GCP also uses 'unique resource identifiers' (URIs) for some resources.
